title: PETS: Personalized Eye Tracking System
description: Software release V1.0.0 of PETS (Personalized Eye Tracking System), a head-mounted eye-tracking system demonstrated in lizards, mice, and turtles. This record is the software. The associated manuscript is "An open-source eye-tracking system adaptable to diverse terrestrial vertebrates reveals state-dependent visual acquisition in lizards". Software is released under the MIT License. Printable hardware files (STL and Fusion 360) in this record are released under CC BY 4.0. The associated dataset is https://zenodo.org/records/23016364 (DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23016364). That DOI identifies the dataset, not this software. The dataset contains S1_Data.xlsx, Table_S1.xlsx, a dataset README, and PV_106.zip (the example recording PV_106/2025_09_04/block_015).
